prose: Reuters' read of Anthropic's IPO prospectus: the company routed 47% of its 2025 sales - about $2.16 billion - through cloud partners Amazon and Google, and paid roughly $351 million back in distribution fees. The filing underlines how dependent Anthropic is on a small group of distribution partners even as it heads to the public market. (Summary based on the Techmeme headline and feed excerpt; the full article could not be retrieved.)
